title: At the Playground
text:
We go to the playground in summer. There is a big slide and a red swing. My brother likes the slide. I like the swing.

In autumn the leaves are brown. We play with the leaves. Then we go home and eat soup.

options: A big slide and a red swing

questions.text: What do the children play with in autumn?
What can we infer about the writer?
options: The writer likes to be outside
The writer does not like the playground
The writer is always at home

questions.text: What can we guess about the weather in autumn?

vocabulary.definition: an outdoor area with equipment where children play
a smooth sloping surface that children slide down
a seat hung from ropes that moves back and forth
the flat green or colored parts that grow on trees

paragraph_translations: Vamos ao parquinho no verão. Há um escorregador grande e um balanço vermelho. Meu irmão gosta do escorregador. Eu gosto do balanço.
No outono as folhas ficam marrons. Nós brincamos com as folhas. Depois vamos para casa e comemos sopa.
